notes: in_the_box: qty null means the official list gives no count for that item (only the PTFE tubes carry ×3 on the wiki list).
Independent second extraction (§F quality gate 3). Every spec value is product-scoped: the product has one option value (P2S Combo Starter Kit) and one variant.
The P2S spec sheet describes the P2S printer; the kit adds the AMS 2 Pro, the Filament Buffer, 3 hotends, 4 PLA spools and an LED kit (store page "What's in the Box").
The page's messages bundle carries no P2S 220 V values (its 220 V strings belong to the H2D tables), so the intl_220v rows come from the official spec sheet.
The store page links the spec sheet as "TDS"; it is the P2S spec sheet (document kind spec_sheet), not a technical data sheet.
